en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīya (2), Tikadukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (4) 10.12.
Sanidassanattika, Hetudukādi
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not a root, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not a root, by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not a root, there arises a state that is non-non-visible, non-reacting, and not a root, by way of root condition. Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not a root...
A non-visible and non-reactive non-root phenomenon arises by way of root condition.

Dependent on a non-visible, non-reactive, and non-root phenomenon, both a non-visible, non-reactive, and non-root phenomenon and a non-visible, non-reactive, and non-root phenomenon arise by way of root condition. Dependent on a non-visible, non-reactive, and non-root phenomenon...
States that are non-visible-and-reactive and not-root, and states that are non-visible-and-non-reactive and not-root, arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible-and-reactive and not-root, states that are non-visible-and-reactive and not-root,
and states that are non-visible-and-non-reactive and not-root, arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reactive, and not a root-cause, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reactive, and not a root-cause, by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reactive, and not a root-cause, there arises a state that is non-visible, reactive, and not a root-cause, by way of root-condition. Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reactive, and not a root-cause...
A non-visible and non-reactive state that is not a root arises by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a non-visible, reactive state that is not a root, there arise states that are both non-visible and reactive and non-visible and non-reactive, which are not roots, by way of root-condition. Dependent on a non-visible, reactive state that is not a root...
States that are non-visible-and-non-reactive and not-root arise by way of root-condition from states that are non-visible-and-non-reactive and not-root.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible-and-non-reactive and not-root, states that are non-visible-and-reactive and not-root,
as well as states that are non-visible-and-non-reactive and not-root, arise by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not-root, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not-root, by way of root-condition … six.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, reacting, and not-root, and a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not-root, there arises a state that is non-visible, reacting, and not-root, by way of root-condition … six.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not-root, and a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not-root, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not-root by way of root condition...
six. (Abbreviated. Under root: thirty; under object: nine... pe ... under mutuality: twenty-five... pe ... under non-disappearance: thirty. (Full detail for all.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not-root, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not-root by way of root condition... (Nine for all.)

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-impinging, and not-root-conditioned … (Abbreviated. Under root condition: thirty; under object condition: nine … pe … under mutuality condition: twenty-five … pe … under non-disappearance condition: thirty.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-impinging, and not-root-conditioned … (In all cases:

nine. Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-impinging, and not-root-associated … (Abbreviated. Under root condition: thirty; under object condition: nine … pe … under mutuality condition: twenty-five … pe … under non-disappearance condition: thirty.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-impinging, and not-root;
dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-impinging, and both not-root and rootless; ... pe ... dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-impinging, and both not-rootless and not-root;
... pe ... dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-impinging, and not-root ... [and so forth].

Dependent on a state that is non-causal and dissociated [from mind] … Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, non-causal, and dissociated [from mind], as well as non-non-causal … Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, non-causal, and not accompanied by a cause … (Abbreviated.
Under the root condition there are thirty; under the object condition, nine … pe … under the mutuality condition, twenty-five … pe … under the non-disappearance condition, thirty.
Dependent on a state that is non-cognizable, non-demonstrable, with resistance, neither a cause, nor rootless … (In all cases, nine.)
